name: Imagery Change Review
description: Processes two imported images (dates, coordinates, resolution) and routes the comparison to a person.
legal_notes: Public, passive sources only. Respect each source's terms and keep to targets you own or have a documented reason to examine.
quota_note: No network requests (works on local data)
example_output: A de-duplicated dataset saved as evidence, with every finding linked to its source response.
capability_gaps: No automatic image registration or change detection: the comparison is a documented manual review.
instructions: Processes two imported images (dates, coordinates, resolution) and routes the comparison to a person.
